name: list_notebooks
title: List notebooks
description: Lists the Devot notebooks that allow AI access, with their IDs and how many notes each holds. Notes can only be created in these notebooks.

name: search_notes
title: Search notes
description: Full-text search over the titles and Markdown of notes in notebooks that allow AI access. Every word must appear (case-insensitive substrings); "quote" a phrase, put - before a word or a qualifier to exclude it, and narrow with title:, body:, book: or in:, tag: or #name, status: or is:, bookId:, tagId: or pinned:true|false (quote names with spaces: book:"Weekly notes"; single quotes work too). Returns the best matches with a snippet of each; read_note gives the full text.

query.description: Words, "quoted phrases", -exclusions and qualifiers such as tag:name

name: read_note
title: Read a note
description: Reads one note by ID: its Markdown, title, notebook, status, pinned state, tags and times. Only notes in notebooks that allow AI access can be read.

name: list_tags
title: List tags
description: Lists the tags on notes in notebooks that allow AI access, by name, with how many of those notes carry each.

name: create_note
title: Create a note
description: Creates a note in a notebook that allows AI access, named by ID or exact name (see list_notebooks). The body is Markdown. Returns the new note ID.

notebook.description: A notebook ID or exact name

name: update_note
title: Update a note
description: Changes a note in a notebook that allows AI access. Pass only what changes: title; the body as either markdown (the whole new body) or patches (exact passages to replace, applied in order; each find text must occur exactly once); notebook (ID or exact name of a notebook that allows AI access); tags (the complete new list of tag names; new names become tags); status. The text from before the edit is kept in the note history. Returns the note as read_note would.

markdown.description: The whole new body, in Markdown

patches.description: Passages to replace, instead of markdown

find.description: Text in the body, exactly as read_note shows it

notebook.description: A notebook ID or exact name

tags.description: All tag names the note should have ([] removes every tag)

name: append_to_note
title: Append to a note
description: Adds text to a note in a notebook that allows AI access without rewriting its body: at the end of the section under a heading (heading, matched by its text in any case; the section ends before the next heading of the same or a higher level), or at the end of the note. position prepend puts it at the start of the section instead. The text goes on a line of its own unless separator is none. A heading the note does not have is an error. Returns the note as read_note would.

heading.description: The heading whose section takes the text, as in the note (its # marks may be left out)

position.description: At the end of the section (default) or at its start

separator.description: newline (default) starts a new line for the text; none joins it to the line it lands on

name: trash_note
title: Move a note to the Trash
description: Moves a note in a notebook that allows AI access to the Trash. It is not deleted: the owner can restore it from the Trash in Devot.

name: create_notebook
title: Create a notebook
description: Creates a notebook with Allow AI Access on, at the top level or inside a notebook that allows AI access (parent: ID or exact name). Returns its ID.

parent.description: A notebook ID or exact name
